summary: Portfolio tracking (Initiative 3). Implement done 2026-09-26 on feature/epic-003-portfolio-tracking (9 commits), not pushed/deployed. Pending: real Neon driver run of opt-in spec, deploy (migrate 0002 first), AC17/AC20 post-deploy. Artifacts in Vietnamese.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Originator is the owner (own need): <20 coins across 2-3 exchanges/wallets, checks each app by hand. No other user has asked yet.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Pain: no total value, no PnL vs cost, no day-over-day change, has to open several apps. Success metric: >=1 non-owner chat records a portfolio within 30 days.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Out of scope (owner): paid tiers, non-Zalo channels. Manual entry vs exchange/wallet sync + trade history: owner delegated to spec.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Spec approved 2026-09-25 with all 7 PO decisions: manual entry (sync later), weighted-average cost, private chats only (groups refused, no financial data in logs), rolling 24h change, VND at fixed rate, only /gia-priceable coins, 200 trades / 20 held coins per chat. AC20 (tolerance = price-source spread) accepted.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Implemented on feature/epic-003-portfolio-tracking (branched from feature/epic-002-fix-alert-monitoring): 6d0e596, 565168a, fd907f7, b4297af, 6613782, a145c63, 84943a7, 823047b, 7a42412. Unit 185->268, e2e 23->38 pass, opt-in skipped 8->23.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Store = Neon Postgres via neon() HTTP; each write is one sql.transaction: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(chat_id)) then INSERT...HAVING / DELETE...NOT EXISTS carrying no-oversell, 200 trades, 20 held coins. quantity NUMERIC(21,8) (plan said 20,8 - 1e12 needs 21 digits).

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: PGlite cannot run under Jest without --experimental-vm-modules (its ESM and CJS builds both await import("module")). Dropped from deps; store SQL proven once manually (15/15 scenarios). Real Neon driver path still unrun: opt-in test/portfolio.postgres.e2e-spec.ts needs a Neon branch or Docker proxy before merge.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: /danhmuc only for chat_type PRIVATE (missing counts as group). Logs never carry amounts; DB errors logged as name + SQLSTATE only. Deploy order: npm run db:migrate (0002) before vercel deploy.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: scripts/db-migrate.js now exports splitStatements/applyMigrations (CLI unchanged) so tests run the exact migration code. Local lint on Windows needs prettier endOfLine:auto (CRLF working copy); no .gitattributes yet.

reflections.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
reflections.text: Spent several attempts on an in-process Postgres (PGlite) before checking whether its loader works under Jest CJS at all. Next time: probe a new test dependency in the real runner with a 5-line spike before building an adapter around it. Also: walking the digest failure order found ZaloService resolving false being counted as sent - check return values, not just throws.
